data.name: Jagbir
data.gender_notes: Jagbir is used as a male name in Hindu naming traditions.
data.long_meaning: Jag means 'victorious' and bir means 'Lord'. This name is derived from the Sanskrit language and is a tribute to the divine victor. In Hindu mythology, Jagbir refers to the mighty and powerful deity, Lord Krishna, who is known for his victories over evil. The name Jagbir carries the meaning “Victorious Lord” and is chosen by families in Hindu traditions for the positive qualities it expresses. Linguistically it belongs to the Sanskrit tradition and is also used in Hindi, Sanskrit, Marathi. Parents who choose Jagbir usually hope their child will grow to embody victorious lord and live with faith, good character and purpose.
data.etymology: Jagbir belongs to the Sanskrit linguistic tradition and is used in Hindu naming. Its recorded meaning is “Victorious Lord.”
data.numerology_meaning: In Pythagorean numerology the letters of Jagbir total 2, giving a life-path number of 2. Number 2 is linked with Moon and with the qualities of harmony, sensitivity and partnership.
